Authorization vs capture vs settlement

Authorization reserves or approves funds; capture requests collection; settlement transfers funds
through the financial system. Exact stages vary by method.
Authorization එක funds approve Jහහෝ hold කර/වනො. Capture එක collection request කර/වනො.
Settlement එJකන් funds financial accounts අතර transfer Jව/වනො.
An online shop authorizes before shipping and captures on dispatch.
